project_notes:
Equipment data updated from supplied manufacturer documents: Trina Solar TSM-NEG21C.20 (720 W), Deye SUN-125K-SG02HP3-EU-GM10, Deye MC-L522 ESS brochure, and supplied MC-L522-BC + 125k H-INV system diagram. Module width corrected from 1333 mm to 1303 mm. Cached PV/BESS, shadow and 3D electrical-route results were cleared and must be recalculated. Important review item: existing String 32 contains 21 modules. With the corrected 720 W module data, its STC Vmp is about 867.3 V and Voc about 1037.4 V, above the inverter's 850 V MPPT upper limit and 1000 V maximum PV input voltage respectively. The string topology was not changed automatically.
